line: e4 e5 Nf3 Nc6 Nc3 Nf6 d4 Bb4
teaches: Before making a capture in the centre, check whether the piece you are counting on to recapture is pinned — a bishop pinning a knight to the king removes that knight from every calculation, and captures that looked safe stop being safe.
explains: It is tempting to grab in the centre with a capture on e5 here — but don't, and here is exactly why. The bishop on b4 pins the knight on c3 to the king, and that knight cannot legally move at all. So take on e5 and you simply drop a pawn: Black snaps e4 and nothing recaptures, because the only guard is frozen. Instead push the d-pawn past — it grabs space and kicks the knight on c6 to a new square.
